title: scatterem
description:
Direct (single-side-band) ptychography, tilt-corrected dark-field imaging, and their SSNR-weighted Wiener fusion for 4D-STEM data. The fusion combines the two channels with weights set by their signal-to-noise ratio as a function of spatial frequency, giving a single image that carries the low-frequency phase contrast of ptychography together with the high-frequency detail of the dark-field channel, without the transfer gap either has alone.

This is the code released with You et al., Advanced Science (2026), doi:10.1002/advs.76620. The public tree is generated from a private development repository by an explicit manifest, so what is published is decided file by file rather than by omission.
